title: Baseline file
description: A baseline is a YAML file with name, date, the stored selection, the commit of every repository involved and ID plus version of every element in the selection (D-039, SR-050, ADR-0018). ReqSeq writes the file once and never changes or replaces it; a person commits it with Git (D-036, D-045). No reason or approval field (D-006). The metamodel of the baseline is given by the commit of the metamodel repository (D-021). ReqSeq writes the keys in this order, one entry per line; a file in another layout is read too, more slowly.

date.description: When the baseline was created, in UTC without fractions. Its day is the UTC day (SR-094 AK2).

repositories.description: The repositories of the selected elements, the main repository and the metamodel's, each once with its HEAD commit (SR-050 AK4).

repository.description: The repository of the copy, relative to the repository of the baseline file: given when they differ or the UUID has copies in several repositories.

elements.description: Sorted by id, then repository (code units; none first), each element copy once; one flow mapping per line.

name.description: Name of a baseline (SR-050), unique in the workspace ignoring case and Unicode normal form. The file name is the name made portable, as attachment names (ADR-0004); a taken file name gets -2, -3, ….

storedSelection.description: The selection the baseline was created with, which SR-051, SR-094 and SR-103 read. ReqSeq writes it canonical: `where` as filter.save writes it, a saved filter as its `where` and `view`, `package` and `view` as `{ id, title }` in the repository of the file and `{ id, repository }` elsewhere (D-058), the title at baseline time; `ids` items without title.

ids.description: A UUID in the repository of the file, `{ id, repository }` elsewhere; one per line, read line by line like `elements` (ADR-0018).

filter.description: Name of a saved filter, as stage 4 files may hold; read with the filter as it is now. Not written.

view.description: `core` (a reference like any other, so not a separate constituent), or the variant as `{ id, title }` or a hand-written reference.

storedRef.description: An element of the stored selection: as written, or any reference a person may write by hand.

elsewhere.description: An element in another repository than the file's (D-058).
